ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: \textbf{Solution:} Solve the system of equations for the two lines to get $\begin{cases}y=-\frac{1}{2}x+6\\ y=\frac{1}{2}x\end{cases}$, and we find: $\begin{cases}x=6\\ y=3\end{cases}$, $\therefore$ the coordinates of point A are $\boxed{(6,3)}$;
